Title: Azure Site Recovery—Zone-to-zone disaster recovery now available

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery brings disaster recovery (DR) protection for virtual machines (VM) in Azure Availability Zones, with zone-to-zone DR. Now if a single Azure availability zone is compromised, fail over your VMs to a different zone within the same region and access them from the secondary availability zone. Zone-to-zone DR is now available in Southeast Asia and UK South.

Learn more.
